summary.text: Matt Kishman is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 50 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. The director of operations at Kishman’s IGA Markets, he is vice chair of the House Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kishman, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Kishman, earned a B.A. in communication from Youngstown State University.
His career experience includes working as director of operations at Kishman’s IGA Markets.

He has served on the Minerva Village Parks Board, the Sandy Creek Joint Fire District Board and the Minerva Chamber Board of Directors, and has been affiliated with the National Grocers Association, Minerva Rotary Club, Stark County Farm Bureau and the NRA.
Kishman defeated Doremus Redvine in the November 2024 general election for District 50.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Energy, Local Government (vice chair) and Small Business committees.
